objective.why:
THE BEST LIST, OWNERSHIP IGNORED. The pilot's instruction was explicit: the absolute best deck, cost is not a constraint. So this is chosen against the 6,703-deck EDHREC aggregate and the deck's own measured behaviour, not against what is in a box.

EVERY ADD SERVES ONE PLAN: cast an enchantment, get a body, give it deathtouch, lifelink and hexproof for free, convert the lifelink into drain the table cannot block.

  Hallowed Haunting -- at seven enchantments, and this list runs 44, CREATURES YOU CONTROL HAVE FLYING AND VIGILANCE, and every enchantment CAST mints a token whose power and toughness each equal the number of enchantments you control. With True Conviction already here that token has double strike and lifelink too.
  Sigil of the Empty Throne -- a 4/4 flier per enchantment CAST. It replaces Ajani's Chosen, which made a 2/2 per enchantment ENTERING, and it respects the lesson drain-v3 and drain-v4 both taught the hard way: REPLACE the bodies, never just delete them.
  Soaring Lightbringer -- flying for other enchantment creatures, and its attacking Glimmer tokens ARE enchantment creatures, so they take the commander's grant natively. 63.9% of the meta.
  Starfield Mystic -- enchantment spells cost one less. drain-v2 bought its result with a curve, 2.667 to 2.905, and drain-v3 tried to pay that back by CUTTING and measured worse on every axis. This pays it back without cutting anything.
  Mesa Enchantress -- the meta's most-included absent card at 72.6%, and readable for the first time as of this session's cast-draw channel.
  Opalescence -- unconditional mass animation, with no five-enchantment threshold unlike Starfield of Nyx, and likewise readable only as of this session.
  Extinguish All Hope -- destroy all NONENCHANTMENT creatures. A ONE-SIDED BOARD WIPE for a deck whose entire board is enchantment creatures.
  Doomwake Giant -- constellation -1/-1 to the table, which is removal that fires off the deck's own density.

THE EIGHT CUTS ARE CARDS THAT DO NOT SERVE IT. Gremlin Tamer and Ajani's Chosen make tokens that are NOT enchantments and take no grant. Transcendent Envoy discounts AURA spells in a list running four Auras. Nighthowler and Eidolon of Countless Battles are bestow creatures weak at both ends. Balemurk Leech is a two-mana body outside the type. Summoner's Sending and Eidolon of Astral Winds are marginal.

WHAT THIS HARNESS CANNOT GRADE, STATED RATHER THAN HIDDEN. Extinguish All Hope is worth ZERO to the goldfish, which has no opponents and no removal. So is every point of evasion from Hallowed Haunting and Soaring Lightbringer, because nothing blocks. And the token triggers on Hallowed Haunting and Sigil fire on CAST, which the constellation pattern does not read -- the module's cast-token profile exists but is scoped to the COMMANDER and matched on creature SUBTYPE, so a card-type gate on a non-commander card is invisible. Half of what makes this list better than drain-v2 will not appear in the numbers. That is a reason to run Forge, not a reason to distrust the cards.

NO TWO-CARD INFINITE. Nothing added gains life from an opponent losing it, and none of the eight is a Game Changer, so the bracket floor holds.

objective.why:
NO HALF MEASURES ON SHRINES, AND THE MATH SAYS WHICH WAY. Five Shrines in a 99 are seen 0.86 times by turn ten, so Sanctum of Stone Fangs -- 'each opponent loses X where X is the number of Shrines' -- drains X=1. Going ALL IN does not rescue it: the full twelve-card cycle reaches 2.06 by turn ten, so the ceiling on the whole plan is X=2. All five are cut.

WHAT REPLACES THEM IS THE AXIS THE COMMANDER ACTUALLY PAYS FOR. Zur, Eternal Schemer grants deathtouth, lifelink and hexproof to enchantment creatures STATICALLY -- no activation, which matters because simulate recorded a MEDIAN OF 0 activations across 60 games -- and {1}{W} turns any non-Aura enchantment into a body whose power is its mana value. The deck already holds 16 native enchantment creatures and 25 animatable enchantments. Lifelink on that board is a lifegain engine; the drain payoffs are what turn it into damage that BLOCKERS CANNOT STOP, which is the deck's real problem: Forge records a median of 2 combat damage a game.

ALL FIVE ADDS ARE ON-TYPE ENCHANTMENTS, so every one is both a payoff and an animate target that is never a dead card. Sanguine Bond is the on-type Vito -- an ENCHANTMENT rather than a creature, so it animates into a 5/5 that drains for its own lifelink, and it is not sleeved in edgar-vampires the way Vito is. Wound Reflection animates to a 6/6 and DOUBLES table-wide life loss. Court of Ambition is a 4/4 that clocks the whole table for 3-6 a turn. Lunar Convocation and Blind Obedience are two-drops on the each-opponent side.

NO TWO-CARD INFINITE. Sanguine Bond's loop needs the 'whenever an opponent loses life, YOU GAIN that much' half -- Exquisite Blood or Bloodthirsty Conqueror -- and neither is in the 99, nor may either ever be added while Sanguine Bond, Vito or Enduring Tenacity is here. A corpus check confirms nothing in the current list carries that clause. None of the five adds is a Game Changer, so the bracket floor holds.

THE OBJECTIVE IS STATED ON A SINGLE-OPPONENT CLOCK AND THAT UNDERSTATES THIS BRANCH. kill_by_8 counts drain (opponent_life is one pool that combat and drain both reduce) but the model tracks ONE opponent, so 'each opponent loses N' is credited N where the pilot's table makes it 3N. Four of the five adds are on that side. A null here is not a null at the table -- see docs/known-issues.md O2 and O3.

objective.why:
DOUBLE THE LIFELINK, AND MAKE WHITE DEVOTION REAL. drain-v1 established the drain axis (+0.0424 on kill_by_8 against an MDE of 0.0195, the first branch in 25 to move anything). This tests the multiplier on it.

TRUE CONVICTION is the single best card this deck can be handed. 'Creatures you control have double strike and lifelink' does four things at once here: it DOUBLES every lifelink trigger and therefore every drain trigger, since Sanguine Bond and Enduring Tenacity fire on the gain and not on the hit; it makes deathtouch lethal in the FIRST-STRIKE step, so a blocker dies before it deals damage and blocking becomes strictly bad; it is a non-Aura enchantment, so the commander or Starfield of Nyx animates it into a 6/6 that is never a dead card; and {W}{W}{W} is THREE WHITE PIPS, which is the devotion the pilot asked for.

DEVOTION IS A TWO-COLOUR PROBLEM IN A THREE-COLOUR DECK. Across the whole 99 the deck has W 37, B 22, U 14. Heliod needs devotion to white of 5 and gets it; Athreos needs white AND black of 7 and gets it; Thassa needs BLUE of 5 against 14 pips in the entire list and essentially never becomes a creature. Thassa stays for the {1}{U} unblockable grant, which works whether or not she is a creature, but nothing else in the deck should be paying blue for devotion that will not arrive.

THE TWO CUTS ARE THE WEAKEST BLUE CARDS AND NOTHING ELSE. Muddle the Mixture counters instants and sorceries ONLY -- the narrowest interaction in the list -- and its transmute costs {1}{U}{U} to find a two-drop. Hypnotic Siren is a 1/1. Enduring Curiosity is NOT cut despite being {2}{U}{U}: 'whenever a creature you control deals combat damage to a player, draw a card' on a board of lifelink bodies is a draw engine, and it returns itself as an enchantment when it dies.

VIRTUE OF PERSISTENCE IS THE CHEAT-IN LINE THE PILOT ASKED FOR, printed on one card. The {1}{B} Adventure half is early removal plus two life -- which is a LIFEGAIN TRIGGER for every drain payoff -- and the {5}{B}{B} enchantment half is an upkeep reanimation engine. The deck already runs both cheat-in routes for it: Academy Rector searches ANY enchantment onto the battlefield when it dies, and Starfield of Nyx returns an enchantment from the graveyard every upkeep.

WHAT THIS BRANCH DELIBERATELY DOES NOT TEST. The pilot's evasion package -- Enter the Enigma, Pym Particles, Artful Dodge, Splash Portal -- is EXCLUDED because the goldfish has no blockers and reads 'can't be blocked' only in Aura and Equipment form. Evasion is worth exactly zero to this harness and can only measure as a loss, which is what sank reach-v1. That line is a FORGE question and must be tested with simulate, not here. Recorded rather than quietly dropped.

STILL NO TWO-CARD INFINITE. Neither add carries 'whenever an opponent loses life, you gain that much', and True Conviction is not a Game Changer, so the bracket floor holds.

objective.why:
PAY THE CURVE TAX BACK. drain-v2 measured +0.0742 on kill_by_8 against an MDE of 0.0197 -- nearly four times what the run can resolve -- but it bought that with a CURVE: average mana value 2.667 -> 2.905 and cards at mv5+ going 3 -> 7. The bill arrived as card draw, 2.43 -> 1.53 by turn eight, and the mechanism is not a missing draw spell. It is that fewer enchantments LAND by turn eight, so Entity Tracker, Caretaker's Talent and Tocasia's Welcome -- all of which draw when an enchantment enters -- fire less often. Same tax that sank shrines-v4, which raised the curve 2.67 -> 2.79 and measured -0.068.

SO THE FIX IS CHEAPER, NOT MORE. Three cuts, all at mv2 or above, none of which feeds the drain: Gremlin Tamer makes 1/1 tokens that are not enchantments and take no grant, Ajani's Chosen makes 2/2 tokens that do the same at twice the cost, and Cathars' Crusade is a five-drop whose counters do nothing for a plan that wins on LIFEGAIN rather than on power.

THREE ADDS, EVERY ONE A WHITE ENCHANTMENT AT MV1-2. Ajani's Welcome is the key card: 'whenever a creature enters the battlefield under your control, you gain 1 life' turns EVERY body -- including the Bitterblossom Faeries and the Archon's Pegasi this deck already makes -- into a lifegain trigger, and a lifegain trigger is a DRAIN trigger with Sanguine Bond, Vito or Enduring Tenacity on the board. Nyx-Fleece Ram is an enchantment creature, so it takes deathtouch, lifelink and hexproof natively, and its upkeep lifegain is a drain every turn for one mana. Alseid of Life's Bounty is a one-mana enchantment creature that already has lifelink printed on it.

ALL THREE ARE WHITE, which is the devotion the pilot asked to concentrate: white is 37 pips against blue's 14, Heliod turns on at five and Athreos at seven across white and black.

STILL FINITE. Ajani's Welcome gives one trigger per body and Nyx-Fleece Ram one per upkeep. Nothing added gains life FROM an opponent losing life, so no loop closes. None is a Game Changer.

THE EVASION PACKAGE IS STILL NOT HERE, and the reason has not changed: the goldfish has no blockers and reads 'can't be blocked' only in Aura and Equipment form, so Enter the Enigma, Pym Particles and Artful Dodge are worth exactly zero to this harness. Splash Portal is additionally wrong for this list -- its cantrip needs a Bird, Frog, Otter or Rat and the deck has none. That package is a FORGE test.

objective.why:
OPALESCENCE, AND THE MODEL GAP THAT HID IT. The goldfish read mass animation from one pattern -- 'as long as you control five or more enchantments' -- and its comment asserted Starfield of Nyx was the only card in the corpus that did this. A sweep of all 34,890 oracle cards for the broad shape returns TWO. Opalescence says 'each other non-Aura enchantment is a creature ... base power and base toughness each equal to its mana value' with NO CONDITION AT ALL, and it returned mass_animate_threshold=0 -- the sentinel for a card that does not mass-animate. The strictly stronger of the two was worth exactly nothing to the model, and the casting predicate gates on the same field, so nothing would ever have cast it either. Fixed in this branch's commit with the sweep recorded and a test that fails when the branch is removed.

WHY IT IS THE UNLOCK RATHER THAN A GOOD CARD. This deck runs 44 enchantments. Opalescence stands ALL of them up at once, permanently, for no mana and no activation -- which matters because simulate recorded a MEDIAN OF 0 activations across 60 games, so anything resting on the commander's {1}{W} is not a plan the pilot's own table has ever seen executed. Every body it makes is an ENCHANTMENT CREATURE, so every one takes deathtouch, lifelink and hexproof from the commander, and with True Conviction already in this line every one has double strike. A 6/6 double-striking deathtouch lifelink body gains 12 life a swing, and 12 life is 12 DRAIN with Sanguine Bond, Vito or Enduring Tenacity on the board.

IT ALSO INVERTS THE CURVE PROBLEM. drain-v2 bought its result with a curve -- average mana value 2.667 -> 2.905 -- and drain-v3 tried to pay that back with cheap cards and measured WORSE on every axis. Under Opalescence an expensive enchantment is not a liability, it is a LARGER BODY: Wound Reflection stops being a six-drop that does nothing alone and becomes a 6/6.

MESA ENCHANTRESS FIXES THE ONE COST drain-v2 ACTUALLY PAID. Extra cards by turn eight fell 2.43 -> 1.53. 'Whenever you cast an enchantment spell, you may draw a card' in a deck of 44 enchantments is the direct answer, and it is the ONLY enchantress in this colour identity -- Argothian, Verduran, Satyr and Sythis are all green and Enchantress's Presence is green. It is already in a box.

THE TWO CUTS ARE THE TOKEN-MAKERS WHOSE TOKENS TAKE NO GRANT. Gremlin Tamer makes 1/1 Gremlins and Ajani's Chosen makes 2/2 Cats; neither token is an enchantment, so neither gets deathtouch, lifelink or hexproof, and both cards are on the buy list. Cathars' Crusade is deliberately NOT cut -- drain-v3 cut it on the theory that counters do nothing for a lifegain plan and measured worse everywhere, because it was pumping the board, the board was dealing combat damage, and that damage was drawing cards off Enduring Curiosity.

RISK, STATED. Opalescence animates every other non-Aura enchantment INCLUDING OPPONENTS', and it turns the pilot's own permanents into creatures that a board wipe kills. The goldfish has no opponents and no removal, so it can see NEITHER cost. Hexproof from the commander answers targeted removal and answers nothing else. This is a FORGE question the moment the goldfish says yes.

STILL NO TWO-CARD INFINITE and neither add is a Game Changer.

'Enchantment spells you cast cost {1} less' pays it back without cutting anything, and it is redundancy on Inquisitive Glimmer, which the deck already runs and which the same measurement says is not enough on its own.

SIGIL OF THE EMPTY THRONE (48.2%, syn +0.43) REPLACES A WORSE VERSION OF ITSELF. Ajani's Chosen makes a 2/2 Cat when an enchantment ENTERS; the Sigil makes a 4/4 white Angel WITH FLYING when an enchantment is CAST. Twice the body, evasive, in a deck with 44 triggers. This also respects the lesson drain-v3 and drain-v4 both taught the hard way -- cutting a token-maker costs card draw, because this deck's draw runs through Enduring Curiosity on combat damage -- by replacing the bodies rather than deleting them.

EVERY ADD IS IN A BOX AND EVERY CUT IS ON THE BUY LIST, so this branch makes the deck cheaper as well as better. Transcendent Envoy discounts AURA spells in a list that runs four Auras.

TWO CARDS THE META RATES HIGHLY ARE DELIBERATELY HELD BACK, because this harness cannot see either and including them would corrupt the reading. EXTINGUISH ALL HOPE (55.0%, and already in a box) destroys all NONENCHANTMENT creatures -- a one-sided board wipe for a deck whose entire board is enchantment creatures -- and the goldfish models no opponents and no removal, so it is worth exactly zero here. SOARING LIGHTBRINGER (63.9%, syn +0.60) grants flying to other enchantment creatures and makes attacking 1/1 Glimmer ENCHANTMENT tokens that take the commander's grant, and evasion is likewise invisible to a model with no blockers.
